title: Alignment-Type Labor Reduction on Alignment Plan Work Orders — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
**Clause.** On the open work order of an Alignment Services & Plans alignment plan, an alignment-type reduction takes a percentage of the pricing base off the labor charged, by the alignment type the work order records as performed:

| Alignment type on the work order | Reduction, as a percentage of the pricing base |
|---|---|
| Thrust alignment | 20% |
| Two-wheel alignment | 10% |
| Four-wheel alignment | 0% |

The reduction is worked out on its own, as a percentage of the pricing base, and taken off the labor charged; the labor charged never falls below 0.00. It is read from the type the work order records, not from the type booked for the appointment or the types the line includes.

**Hypothetical illustrations** (pricing bases chosen for the example only):
- pricing base 50.00, thrust alignment: 10.00 is taken off;
- pricing base 50.00, two-wheel alignment: 5.00 is taken off;
- pricing base 50.00, four-wheel alignment: nothing is taken off;
- pricing base 0.00: nothing is taken off, whatever the type.
